title.en: View your schedule by month or week

en: Switch between Month and Week using the same familiar controls as Tickets, and jump straight to Today.
See all seven days of a week, including dates across month and year boundaries.
Spot running shifts in green, normal plans in blue, events in purple, closed days in red, and finished or past days in grey.
ja: チケット画面と同じ操作で月・週の表示を切り替え、今日の予定にすぐ移動できます。
月末や年末をまたぐ週も、7日間すべての予定を確認できます。
営業中は緑、通常の予定は青、イベントは紫、休業日は赤、終了済み・過去の日はグレーで表示します。
